title: General.
officialText:
Stationary fuel-cell power systems having a power output not exceeding 1 MW shall be tested in accordance with
CSA America FC 1 and shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s installation instructions, NFPA 853, the New York
City Building Code, the New York City Fire Code, and with National Electric Code Article 692 Fuel Cell Systems.
SECTION FGC 634
CHIMNEY DAMPER OPENING AREA
